definitions.gloss: to squeeze out; to wring out
definitions.explanation: To physically extract a liquid or substance by squeezing or pressing.

definitions.gloss: to eke out; to muster; to produce with great effort
definitions.explanation: To produce something — words, ideas, energy, money — through great effort, as if squeezing it out of oneself.

examples.japanese: ⟦チューブ→チューブ：11586_chuubu⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧{絞|しぼ}り{出|だ}す。
examples.english: To squeeze out from a tube.

examples.japanese: ぞうきん⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{水|みず}→水：02258_mizu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{絞|しぼ}り{出|だ}した。
examples.english: I wrung the water out of the rag.

examples.japanese: ⟦レモン→レモン：10456_remon⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{最後|さいご}→最後：01413_saigo⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{一滴|いってき}→一滴：08893_itteki⟧⟦まで→まで：00490_made⟧⟦{果汁|かじゅう}→果汁：15335_kajuu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{絞|しぼ}り{出|だ}した。

I managed to squeeze out a voice.

examples.english: I racked my brains and came up with a solution.

examples.japanese: ⟦{残|のこ}り→残り：01622_nokori⟧わずかな⟦{体力|たいりょく}→体力：05318_tairyoku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{絞|しぼ}り{出|だ}して、⟦ゴール→ゴール：03845_gooru⟧⟦まで→まで：00490_made⟧⟦{走|はし}り{切|き}った→走り切る：28375_hashirikiru⟧。
examples.english: I mustered my last remaining strength and ran all the way to the finish.

notes:
A compound verb combining ⟦{絞|しぼ}る→絞る：03926_shiboru⟧ (to squeeze, to wring) and ⟦{出|だ}す→出す：01087_dasu⟧ (to put out, to produce). The figurative sense (sense 2) is extremely common and vivid — the image of squeezing something out of oneself with difficulty.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{声|こえ}→声：02207_koe⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{絞|しぼ}り{出|だ}す — to force out a voice (when one can barely speak)
- ⟦{知恵|ちえ}→知恵：03428_chie⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{絞|しぼ}り{出|だ}す — to rack one's brains
- ⟦{勇気|ゆうき}→勇気：02499_yuuki⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{絞|しぼ}り{出|だ}す — to muster courage
- ⟦{体力|たいりょく}→体力：05318_tairyoku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{絞|しぼ}り{出|だ}す — to summon one's last strength
- ⟦{涙|なみだ}→涙：02235_namida⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{絞|しぼ}り{出|だ}す — to squeeze out tears

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{絞|しぼ}る→絞る：03926_shiboru⟧ — to squeeze, to wring; the base verb without the 'out' nuance
- ⟦{振|ふ}り{絞|しぼ}る→振り絞る：12817_furishiboru⟧ — to muster (strength, courage); emphasizes gathering from reserves
- ⟦{搾|しぼ}り{取|と}る→搾り取る：14963_shiboritoru⟧ — to squeeze out, to exploit; often has a negative connotation of extraction
